_comment: macroengine:item_modifier/set_custom_model_data — BACKPORT (1.21.2): custom_model_data changed from a plain int to the {floats,flags,strings,colors} object format in pack format 59 (24w45a / 1.21.4). 1.21.2 is pack format 57, so this uses the old int form.
